title: Kailil
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Zevachim 118b Rav Yosef said: “Kailil had one son (that is, Abaye), and he was not set right.” Hyman identifies him as Rabbah’s brother, as cited in the Arukh, entry Abaye, from a responsum of Rav Sherira Gaon. Hyman relates that he died while his wife was pregnant and she subsequently gave birth to Abaye. Yuchasin reads Bailil, but Yuchasin HaShalem has Kailil.

notes.text: The brother relationship, death while his wife was pregnant and Abaye’s subsequent birth are Hyman’s biographical account. The supplied “not set right” expression and its earlier uncertainty are retained rather than replaced with a new historical conclusion.

The consulted Zevachim 118b has the quoted remark, and Rashi says that Kailil appears to be Abaye’s father. The exact Arukh, Rav Sherira responsum and Yuchasin edition readings cited here were not independently inspected and remain Hyman’s report.
